title: Filtering the customers table by text

steps.title: Keep rows where name is Brahim Belkadi
steps.prompt:
WHERE is a sieve: only rows that pass the test stay.
Text values wear quotes, like 'Brahim Belkadi'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE name = 'Brahim Belkadi';
hints: Wrap the text value in single quotes.
Write: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE name = 'Brahim Belkadi';
steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE name = 'Brahim Belkadi';

steps.title: Search with LIKE for names starting 'Bra'
steps.prompt:
LIKE searches by pattern using the % wildcard.
Bra% means 'starts with'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE name LIKE 'Bra%';
hints: Write: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE name LIKE 'Bra%';
steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE name LIKE 'Bra%';

steps.title: Search with LIKE for 'rah' anywhere
steps.prompt:
Putting % on BOTH sides matches the text anywhere.
This %rah% means 'contains'.
steps.task: Try typing: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE name LIKE '%rah%';
hints: Wrap the text in %% on both sides.
Write: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE name LIKE '%rah%';
steps.expected_sql: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE name LIKE '%rah%';
